settings.breed_blurb: Friendly, energetic and always camera-ready — Golden Retrievers love dressing up for every occasion.
settings.tip_lehenga: Flared lehengas with broad yokes look stunning on Golden Retrievers — choose fabrics that allow free leg movement.
settings.tip_sherwani: A structured sherwani with a neck band accentuates the Golden Retriever's natural elegance. Deep jewel tones like burgundy and navy work beautifully.
settings.tip_tshirt: Lightweight cotton tees are ideal for summer walks. Choose printed or graphic styles for a playful everyday look.
settings.tip_colours: Warm oranges, royal blues and jewel-toned burgundies contrast beautifully with the Golden Retriever's golden coat.
